snippet.title: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 3: Echoes of the Rebellion – Launch Trailer –  Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Season 3 is starting to heat up—or should we say ice up? Highlights include: the arrival of Pilbush, the new Hoth Frontline battlefield, the Season 3 Arena Pass, Emotes, new Limited Time Events, the return of Boulder Bash, and much more! Enter the Arena and Play Season 3 of Star Wars: Hunters, available now on Nintendo Switch! 

🧊: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-wars-hunters-switch/  

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://www.nintendo.com/us/
